title: No responses from applications? Fix your resume ✍️
description:
Keywords are king—and you want to make sure you have the right ones in your resume so it stands out to recruiters and hiring managers. But how can you find the keywords? Using the Teal platform to run your job search makes this all very easy. You can find the keywords in the Teal Job Tracker next to the job description or in Matching Mode in the Teal Resume Builder. #resume #resumebuilder #resumetips
